wrong-day-negative (its clauses are phrased in the twin band)

reflectivity_parameters.frequency_matched_definition: the model threshold is the linear-interpolated quantile of the model field over the shared-valid scored cells at 1 - f_obs, so model and observed exceedance coverage agree
reflectivity_parameters.fss_definition: Roberts & Lean 2008 with a shared validity mask: neighborhood fraction = boxcar(event AND valid)/boxcar(valid); cells with an empty neighborhood are dropped; FSS = 1 when both fraction fields are identically zero over the scored region
reflectivity_parameters.missing_policy: observed missing or flagged cells are excluded from both fields; an arm with a missing frame fails, it is not skipped
reflectivity_parameters.model_field: column maximum over k of REFL_10CM, each model's own scheme-consistent reflectivity operator
reflectivity_parameters.primary_scalar: mean over the scored leads of FSS at the primary threshold and primary neighborhood

regrid_sensitivity.note: the registered choice stands unless this delta exceeds the twin band, which does not exist until the twin pair runs; the delta is published now so that comparison is one subtraction later

station_shuffle_machinery.note: the registered station-shuffle-mutation control compares a real arm's RMSE with and without the derangement and asks whether the rise exceeds the twin band; neither exists yet, so what is measured here is the derangement itself and the rise a perfect arm would suffer under it

wrong_day_drops.criterion_note: the registered wrong-day control asks for three clauses: the score drops, the drop exceeds the twin band, and the wrong-day score falls below 0.5 + f_obs/2. Two are decidable from observations alone and are answered here; the twin-band clause holds for any band below the drop reported here
